messages:
Priya: Quick pulse 5m prepping a 3-week preview for the Neon cohort. Need: enrollment email, in-app checklist, and a day-7 micro-survey to capture early friction and intent to renew.
Marco: timeline? how many accounts are we running with?
Priya: 30 accounts, staggered over 3 days. goal = surface activation vs churn signals for renewal ops.
Sam: telemetry needs: `preview_enrolled`, `checklist_completed`, `day7_survey_submitted`, `usage_active_days`. will join with billing to model renewal risk.
Zoe: quick legal note 5m: make sure opt-in copy is explicit; no pre-checked boxes. link to privacy in modal required.
Marco: agree on no pre-check. also want an A/B: modal opt-in vs email follow-up to see which yields higher survey participation.
Priya: A/B good. split 50/50 across the 30 accounts. Marco you own email + in-app copy. Sam you own telemetry + the rule. Zoe sign-off on copy by Wed.
Sam: proposed simple activation rule to flag AMs: if `usage_active_days` < 3 in first 14 days AND `day7_survey_score` <= 6 -> tag `preview:activation-risk`. Ping AMs channel + assign playbook. snippet below for the alert payload we9ll emit: 
```
{
  "account_id": "<acct_id>",
  "tag": "preview:activation-risk",
  "reason": "low_activation_and_low_nps",
  "metrics": {"usage_active_days": 2, "day7_survey_score": 5}
}
```
Marco: nice. playbook for AMs should be 3 actions max: 1) quick check-in call, 2) offer enablement walkthrough, 3) share 1-page checklist. I9ll template that.
Zoe: copy draft link: https://tiny.redwood/privacy-preview-copy 5m will add required blurb.
deploy-bot: feature flags for preview rollouts scheduled 2026-05-10T02:00:00Z 5m will announce in #eng-platform after deploy. :white_check_mark:
Priya: owners recap: Marco = enrollment + playbook + Loom, Sam = telemetry + alert rule, Zoe = legal copy, Priya = cohort orchestration + readout.
Marco: I'll draft email + in-app text today and post for review.
Sam: staging events wired by Fri, will add mock dashboard for AMs.
Zoe: sign-off pending minor copy tweak; expect done Wed afternoon.
Priya: thanks team 5m small pilot but should give high signal on renewal risk drivers. will run a 2-week readout after cohort finishes. :rocket:
